title: New City Budget Details
summary:
*   A special meeting was held solely to present the city's proposed Fiscal Year 1988-89 Operating Budget and Capital Improvements plan.
*   Acting City Manager John Ware and Budget Director Sarah Farley led the detailed presentation of the upcoming financial blueprint.
*   The session focused entirely on the budget's unveiling; no policy decisions were made, nor were any public hearings conducted.
